paper.title: Vitamin D supplements and bone density in older women

paper_text:
Vitamin D supplements and bone density in older women
Rossi, E., Wang, H.  J. Fake Medicine, 2019

Abstract
In 300 women aged 65+, 1000 IU daily vitamin D raised hip bone density by 2.1% over a year.

Results
See Figure 2.

alerts.description: A retraction notice was published for this paper.

notice.text:
Retraction: Vitamin D supplements and bone density in older women

This article has been retracted after the authors found a coding error in the analysis that invalidates the main result. The reported 2.1% increase in bone density was not reproducible.
